RestoreWindow.description: Earliest and latest time a DB cluster can be restored to.

EarliestTime.description: The earliest time you can restore a DB cluster to.

LatestTime.description: The latest time you can restore a DB cluster to.

Tag.description: Metadata assigned to an Amazon RDS resource consisting of a key-value pair.

Key.description: A key is the required name of the tag.

Value.description: A value is the optional value of the tag.

schema.description: Resource type definition for AWS::RDS::DBClusterAutomatedBackup. An automated backup of an Aurora DB cluster, consisting of the cluster volume backup, transaction logs, and the DB cluster properties that existed at the time the source cluster was deleted.

AllocatedStorage.description: For all database engines except Amazon Aurora, specifies the allocated storage size in gibibytes (GiB). For Aurora, this value is always 1.

AvailabilityZones.description: The Availability Zones where instances in the DB cluster can be created.

BackupRetentionPeriod.description: The retention period for the automated backups.

ClusterCreateTime.description: The time when the DB cluster was created, in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

DBClusterArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the source DB cluster.

DBClusterAutomatedBackupsArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the automated backups of the DB cluster.

DBClusterIdentifier.description: The identifier of the source DB cluster.

DbClusterResourceId.description: The resource ID of the source DB cluster, which can't be changed and which is unique to an AWS Region.

Engine.description: The name of the database engine for this automated backup.

EngineMode.description: The engine mode of the database engine for the automated backup.

EngineVersion.description: The version of the database engine for the automated backup.

IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled.description: Indicates whether mapping of AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) accounts to database accounts is enabled.

KmsKeyId.description: The AWS KMS key ID for an automated backup.

MasterUsername.description: The master user name of the automated backup.

Port.description: The port number that the automated backup used for connections.

Region.description: The AWS Region associated with the automated backup.

Status.description: The status of the automated backup: retained for a deleted DB cluster, or active while the source cluster still exists.

StorageEncrypted.description: Indicates whether the source DB cluster is encrypted.

Tags.description: A list of tags assigned to the automated backup.
